notes.title: 1.0.3 Close Call, Swarmer Fix, and Typos
notes.content:
Added new achievement "Close Call" you earn by surviving a boss crashing into your turret, which is now possible since a bug where Bosses would stop advancing past a certain point has been patched.

Patched a bug where certain damage methods would cause Swarmers and Swarmlords to split into more enemies than intended. I also corrected some typos in certain attachment descriptions.

If you haven't already checked it out, the discord is a great place to report any bugs you find and share strategies: https://discord.gg/YrEvfp3Ak7

notes.title: Lonely Turret Official Discord
notes.content:
It's been a great few weeks for Lonely Turret 2 and it's gotten more interest than any game I've published in the past. I put together a Discord server for easy discussion, questions, or bug reports, and as just a place to hang out or talk with fellow players.

Check it out here:
https://discord.gg/YrEvfp3Ak7

notes.title: 1.0.2.1 Quick GUI Fix
notes.content: Update 1.0.2 had the unintended side effect of... uh... the entire pause menu being broken. It should be fixed now, sorry about that.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Upgrade Countdown, Tutorial Changes, Small Fixes
notes.content: The GUI has received a new "Next Upgrade" countdown, and the level 1 tutorial goes into more detail. In addition, a minor texture issue with the second boss for level 1 has been resolved. Level 1 had to have some maintenance done after some trouble, and while I fixed everything I could think of there might still be bugs, so be sure to let me know of any issues you come across.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Release Day Fixes + Tutorial
notes.content: Quick fix on the menu volume bar, which wasn't coloring itself properly, as well as a bug that may have caused problems with how levels unlock. Also added a small tutorial message for level 1 that vanishes after your first upgrade to help new players learn the controls.
